an4.76:3.2: “Perhaps even a single mendicant has doubt or uncertainty regarding the Buddha, the teaching, the Saṅgha, the path, or the practice. So ask, mendicants! Don’t regret it later, thinking:
an4.76:3.3: ‘We were in the Teacher’s presence and we weren’t able to ask the Buddha a question.’”
